text_markup: The Corp uses {card:Nanisivik Grid} to resolve the first subroutine on a copy of {card:Brân 1.0} in Archives. This subroutine attempts to install ice "directly inward" from {card:Brân 1.0}, but this copy of {card:Brân 1.0} is not protecting a server and therefore does not have a position from which "directly inward" can be evaluated. There is no legal way to install a card as directed, so the subroutine will have no effect.
text_plain: The Corp uses Nanisivik Grid to resolve the first subroutine on a copy of Brân 1.0 in Archives. This subroutine attempts to install ice "directly inward" from Brân 1.0, but this copy of Brân 1.0 is not protecting a server and therefore does not have a position from which "directly inward" can be evaluated. There is no legal way to install a card as directed, so the subroutine will have no effect.
